pairs: Confess to the God of gods,
Confess to the Lord of lords,
He made the heavens with understanding,
He established the earth above the waters,
the sun to rule the day,
lunam et stellas in potestatem noctis,
the moon and the stars to rule the night,
Qui percussit Ægyptum cum primogenitis eorum,
He struck Egypt along with their first-born,
Qui eduxit Israël de medio eorum,
He led Israel away from their midst,
in manu potenti et brachio excelso,
with a powerful hand and an outstretched arm,
Qui divisit mare Rubrum in divisiones,
He divided the Red Sea into separate parts,
et eduxit Israël per medium ejus,
And he led out Israel through the middle of it,
et excussit Pharaonem et virtutem ejus in mari Rubro,
And he shook off Pharaoh and his army in the Red Sea,
Qui traduxit populum suum per desertum,
He led his people through the desert,
And he has slaughtered strong kings,
And he granted their land as an inheritance,
as an inheritance for his servant Israel,
Quia in humilitate nostra memor fuit nostri,
For he was mindful of us in our humiliation,
et redemit nos ab inimicis nostris,
And he redeemed us from our enemies,
He gives food to all flesh,
Confitemini Deo cæli, quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus.
Confess to the God of heaven,
Confitemini Domino dominorum, quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus.
Confess to the Lord of lords, for his mercy is eternal.
